authority_selection: none; report all three separately; these are assumed commitment authorities, not observed Chinese rules
objective: existing formal multi-target weighted training loss only; scales recalculated from the same revised training vintage; no evaluation fitting

bioenergy.scope: fixed-composition whole-project statistical bucket scenario; shared 0.3 electrical efficiency; not national waste composition observations
bioenergy.fee_status: real-price sensitivity assumption within company-sample nominal fee range; source VAT and national weights unknown
bioenergy.delivery_status: finite initial reconstruction and bounded growth hypothesis, not future national observations

limits: Existing fleet and reconstructed initial pipeline do not receive new project yields
IEA cost split is a 2025 technical reference held constant, not annual observed fleet costs
No municipal heat revenue without a physical useful-heat model
Statistical PEO remains distinct from physical fossil waste energy and emissions
All grid results and failed trials retained; no threshold relaxation or official-attainment claim

Solar construction response is a calibrated latent capability relative to the 2014 supply envelope; initial pipeline multiplier only affects inherited 2014 queue. Neither is observed annual national capacity.
design_rationale: Two passes permit new-project yield and construction volume to adjust jointly; all selection uses unchanged 2015-2021 multi-target loss. Early solar stock and annual construction constraint identified as major training residuals; no holdout-based authority selection.
